what: Council Item #1 hypothesis c4-preregistered-10pct-reduction-refuted: partial-penalized Ridge (log2 DMSO + CFTR sub-domain + variant class) predicted >= 10% held-out log2 MAE reduction over stronger baseline (dmso_ols) with 95% residue-clustered bootstrap CI > 0.
why: Refuted on 67 untouched Tedman et al. 2025 holdout variants (59 codons): candidate MAE was 0.434782 log2 vs dmso_ols MAE 0.451487 log2 (+3.7001% reduction, 59-cluster 95% bootstrap CI [-0.028005, 0.058719] straddling zero; linear context MAE 0.573246 vs 0.541184). Retained as negative finding without post-hoc retuning.
